name: Mail drop → SharePoint
description: Files each email dragged into the Outlook drop folder into SharePoint (Email.pdf + its attachments, one subfolder per email), then moves it to the filed folder; on any failure it stays in the drop folder and is retried (up to 3 attempts). The 300 s timeout covers a whole email, so one with very large or many attachments can exceed it and stays in the drop folder.
